verdict.rationale: Capacities supports structured object types and properties (docs-26, docs-29, docs-35) and mentions 'Smart queries' in its pricing page (docs-27), implying some query capability, but there is no documentation of actual query syntax, filtering by property, or renderable table/board/list database views like Notion-style databases. missing for 10: documentation or hands-on evidence of a query/filter builder, table/board/list view rendering from queries, saved views, sorting/grouping by property.
